books.title: The Vegan Foodie Guide To Japan
books.imageAlt: Cover of The Vegan Foodie Guide to Japan - Plant-based Travel Book
books.text: Stop worrying about dashi in your miso soup. Drawing on 11 trips worth of experience, this massive 230-page guide is the only resource you need to navigate Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and beyond to have your perfect foodie trip in Japan.
points: Access to 149+ vegan spots across Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and popular day-trip cities like Nara, Kamakura, Kobe and Himeji
Supermarket and Konbini survival guide with label reading cheat sheets for easy snacking
Foodie guide for traditional Japanese sweets, vegan options at Universal Studios Japan and more

books.title: The Vegan Foodie Guide To Thailand
books.imageAlt: Cover of The Vegan Foodie Guide to Thailand - Plant-based Travel Book
books.text: The Vegan Foodie Guide to Thailand is your travel companion designed to help you eat like a local and travel with total confidence. Covering 3 popular cities - Bangkok, Chiang Mai and Phuket.
points: Detailed reviews for over 110 vegan-friendly cafes and restaurants across three major cities
Cultural guides for navigating the Phuket Vegetarian Festival and identifying yellow 'Jay' flags
Essential shopping tips for finding vegan snacks in convenience stores & supermarkets

books.title: The Vegan Foodie Guide To Hong Kong
books.imageAlt: Cover of The Vegan Foodie Guide to Hong Kong - Plant-based Travel Book
books.text: Written by a vegan Hong Kong-er, this book helps you uncover vegan gems from bustling street food markets to sophisticated dining spots in Hong Kong.
points: Locally curated vegan food list across Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, and the New Territories
Vegan food guide for finding egg tarts, pineapple buns and more traditional street food in Hong Kong
Essential Cantonese phrases and local-approved travel tips

books.title: The Vegan Foodie Guide To Taiwan
books.imageAlt: Cover of The Vegan Foodie Guide to Taiwan - Plant-based Travel Book
books.text: Taiwan is a vegan paradise, but navigating the "hidden" ingredients in a different language could be challenging. This ebook gives you a list of best vegan places to visit, as well as help you enjoy pay-by-weight buffets navigate night market, and find hidden vegan gems in supermarkets and convenience stores.
points: Curated restaurant maps and detailed dish recommendations for Taipei, Taichung, and Taoyuan
Vegan night market and pay-by-weight vegetarian buffets guides
Label reading cheat sheet to unlock hidden vegan snacks in convenience stores and supermarkets

books.title: Vegan Asia Foodie Travel Bundle
books.imageAlt: The four vegan travel books in the Vegan Asia Foodie Travel Bundle
books.text: Planning the ultimate Asia vegan food trip? Get the complete collection which include over 800 pages of local knowledge, covering the diverse food cultures of Japan, Thailand, Hong Kong, and Taiwan in one easy download.
